## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — code restructuring (no behavior change)
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — adding or updating tests
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, CI, dependencies, or repo maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] README updated (if user-facing change)
